nodes.label: Customer identity foundation
nodes.summary: Multiple customer phones enable WhatsApp detection and agent-led phone registration; registered customers underpin refaccionaria sales.

nodes.label: Registered customer required for sales
nodes.summary: Every refaccionaria note must link to a registered customer; anonymous sales are disallowed.

nodes.label: Credit-note cashier payment flow
nodes.summary: A seller creates a temporary credit note and the customer pays a cashier immediately; sellers cannot handle physical cash.

nodes.label: Digital return voucher balance
nodes.summary: Return-number-identified, accumulated customer balance is redeemed against another purchase and is anchored to the return note.

nodes.label: Gated cash-refund exception
nodes.summary: Cash returns are prohibited by policy except for rare audited manager/admin exceptions.

nodes.label: Warehouse lead times
nodes.summary: Supplier warehouses can require two to three days; lead time should be shown in sales and quotations.

nodes.label: Warranty workflow
nodes.summary: A multi-role state workflow creates, reviews with images, escalates, authorizes, then replaces goods or grants balance.

nodes.label: Supplier and inventory-logistics foundation
nodes.summary: Supplier entity is the foundation for supplier credit notes, split fulfillment, warehouse lead times, and per-SKU kardex.

nodes.label: Conversational WhatsApp quotations
nodes.summary: The agent accumulates quotation items conversationally and creates the quotation only after customer confirmation.
